To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the research on digital documentation has been growing at an accelerated pace in the last decade, that it has been characterized by its multidisciplinary nature, by the variety of its fields of application, and by its crosscutting topics, and that it is a very active and promising field of research.

the main fields of application of digital documentation are Intranets, scientific and media digital libraries, technological monitoring networks and administrative and citizen services; that the main crosscutting hot topic of the moment are specialized information system models; that the main metadata standards are Dublin Core, the Open Archives Initiative Metadata Harvesting Protocol and the Open Archives Initiative Object Reuse and Exchange; and that the main open code movement projects are Open Source and Free Software.

the digital documentation is a field of research in which the information science is a key discipline that, in turn, is being enriched by contributions from other disciplines, such as the computer science, the library science, the communication science, the sociology, the psychology and the law.
